back: Restoring relationships between people or groups that were in conflict, so that they can live and work together again.

front: What is a **cleansing ritual** in Indigenous Religion?
back: A ceremony by elders to remove spiritual disorder after a violent death or war, so that the living and the dead can be at peace.

front: On what date was the Unity Accord signed?
Which section of the 2013 Constitution created the NPRC?
back: Section 251 (the National Peace and Reconciliation Commission).

front: Which Christian text teaches forgiveness many times?
What are the Shona and Ndebele names for the bring-home ceremony?
How did churches help after the war?
back: They taught forgiveness, gave relief and counselling, helped resettlement, held memorials and documented abuses.

front: Why do families bring home the spirit of a relative who died in the war?
back: It is believed that a person who died violently or was not properly buried may be restless; the rite lets the spirit join the ancestors.

front: Why is healing after conflict not finished?
back: Some families still seek answers and burial places, and healing also needs truth and justice.
